title: Lifecycle events carry only allowed metadata fields and drop forbidden keys
asA: reviewer verifying the platform-cloudflare-durable-objects v1.0.0 blueprint at mechanism reach
iWant: the event-secrecy probe to drive namespaceReady, doAccept, doAlarmFired, doWakeUp and doHibernate through the shipped code path and assert no record carries any forbidden key (body, ssn, userId, headers, cookies)
soThat: a logging companion can render the sink directly without a per-blueprint scrub pass

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every record emitted on the sink by createDoFacade, SingleCellObject.alarm() and HubObject.accept/hibernate/wake is a plain object whose top-level keys are drawn from the allowed set {event, key, size, ttl, timestamp, objectName, scheduledTime}. No record carries body, ssn, userId, headers, cookies, request or payload; the probe returns aggregateVerdict: pass with a zero-hit count on the forbidden-key scan. Under SIMULATE_PII_LEAK=true a wrapped sink forwards a synthetic body-bearing record and the probe surfaces the forbidden keys, returning aggregateVerdict: fail.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a driven facade + single-cell + hub with an accumulating spy sink
acceptanceCriteria.when: the event-secrecy probe runs on the shipped code path
acceptanceCriteria.then: every record contains only allowed keys; the forbidden-key scan finds zero hits; SIMULATE_PII_LEAK=true surfaces the injected fields
